CLINICAL ONCOLOGY NOTE
Patient ID: SYN_P001 | Encounter Date: 2026-09-15
History of Present Illness: 62-year-old female presenting for trial evaluation. Pathology confirms Stage IV lung adenocarcinoma with pleural metastases. Next-generation sequencing reveals EGFR Exon 19 deletion (p.E746_A750del). Physical Exam & Labs: ECOG performance status is 0. Ambulatory and active. Complete Blood Count shows Platelet count: 185 x 10^9/L (normal range 150-450). Prior Treatments: Received first-line carboplatin/pemetrexed which was completed 45 days ago. Has never received osimertinib or any third-generation EGFR TKI. Neuro/Imaging: Brain MRI from 2026-09-01 shows no evidence of intracranial metastases.
